PharmaTrust by NJMC

Certificate analysis you can defend.

PharmaTrust COA Validator is a software product developed and operated by NJMC Medical Supplies Co., Ltd. It reviews pharmaceutical certificates of analysis and lays out the findings against the applicable specification, so a buyer can see what needs a second look.

We built it for our own sourcing work. It is now available to other buyers.

Reports are an Automated Analysis or an Expert-Reviewed Analysis.

Plans, pricing and sign-up: pharmatrust.tech.
